Later measurements or replacement may require controlled removal and refitting so the opening is not unintentionally left exposed. Boarding alone does not establish structural safety or permission to occupy the property.

emergency-board-up-after-fire/garrett.estimate: Opening dimensions, frame condition, panel material and access affect the temporary work. Send photos that show the full opening and any route that must remain usable.
checklist: List every exposed window, door or wall opening.
Identify entries and exits that must stay available.
Show loose framing or nearby utility equipment.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/garrett.intro: Crawl space sewage cleanup in Garrett addresses wastewater that has contacted soil, insulation or framing beneath the floor. We trace the accessible path and remove porous material that cannot be cleaned as part of the proposed scope.

sections.title: Crawl space sewage cleanup in Garrett: extract wastewater before handling settled waste
sections.text: We will establish suitable access and collection routes, then pump or extract reachable wastewater. Settled solids and contaminated debris still need physical removal after the liquid level falls. Continued source discharge must be corrected rather than hidden by repeated pumping.

sections.title: Expose and clean retained contact surfaces
sections.text: Specified affected insulation or ground covering will be contained for disposal where it cannot remain. Accessible retained building components will have soil and residue physically removed before appropriate disinfection. Contaminated soil or surfaces blocked from treatment will receive a separate stated decision rather than a blanket claim of cleanup.

sections.title: Dry the building components before covering them
sections.text: We will measure accessible joists and subfloor and arrange drying for recoverable wet material. The ground condition and retained building structure will have distinct completion findings. Replacement layers follow that work and any necessary repair, with access limitations still identified.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/garrett.estimate: The access route, clearance, contact area and amount of insulation or soil to remove affect the plan. Share the source-repair status and any areas already cleaned.
checklist: Identify the drain, fixture or line involved.
Describe the crawl-space entry and clearance.
Note contacted insulation or debris already removed.
